question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
reference: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti.  Men waɗi ƴamde  dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun  fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi  mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume  heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo?  Ɗume wawi heɓɓa  futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
model_answer: Ɓuuɗol ngol e nder cugale (naawo) e taari (saru) on ko sabu ƴiiƴam ɓuuɓugol e nder ɓanndu, wonaa ko nyau sepperata naatata nder cugale. Nyau nguu ko baawɗe mboro bana malaria walla typhoid mboro on njuutata ko e mette cugale e taari ɓuuɗuɗe. Ɗamɗin hokka mo ndiyam Jewte (ORS) ngam lomtinde ndiyam ko majji e Paracetamol ngam ustude ƴiiƴam. Wanaa naafa lekki leɗɗe walla lekji goɗɗi tawa ko ɗe ngalaa doktoor njoɓɗini, ɗum waawi bonnude ɓingel on. So tawii ƴiiƴam ngal wanaa usta nder balɗe ɗiɗi walla ɓingel on waawi jega, nelngo mo to opitaal ngam ƴeewndaango ƴiiƴam e nder mboro.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer: Alamaaje ɗe kaal-ɗaa ɗe, bano yowreende e ɓuuɓnude yi'ite, dillgol ɓanndu, e muumre ɓaawo ɗuum, ina kollina debbo o ina mari nyau mawñe (epilepsy walla narb). Nyau nguu ko haala ƴiiƴam ɗiɗaɓam (ɓernde) nde waawi cellereede e leɗɗe, ko ɗum waɗi ina teeŋri o yah to safrirde ngam yiyde doktoor o heɓ kuutoragol leɗɗe ko wayi no Phenobarbital. So o heɓi naafoore ndee, woto aɗo huunde e haakonde makko, ko ɓuri moƴƴude ko a lelnda mo e leydi e nokkuure mum ngam ɗiyam ɗam yaltu, a renda hoore makko nde gaaƴa. Omo waawi reende ko heewi waɗde ɗum bano ŋakkere ɗoyngol, omo wanaa leɗɗe makke ɗe no doktoor ɗaɓɓiri ɗum nii ñalnde kala ngam dartina ɗum jamma e ndernde. E nder renndo amen, en foti wallitde mo woppaade njiyaagu, sabu ɗum ko nyau celluɗu ko waawi heefde no nyau assoori nii.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
reference:
Debbo reedujo mo dubi sappane tati e tati mo wodi reedu lebbi jeeɗiɗi keddu en makko ngaddimo Nyaurdorde amin. Ɓe wi'i  reedu mako no nawɗum tenduɗum, ƴiiyan ko ɗuɗi wurti le yeso mako. Ii 'o diwna ,I'o woya ngam nawɗun dun ɓurimo semɓe.  Saro en makko mbii be don kultori ta godɗun tawa Dada ko bingel ngel.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami :  dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?
Ƴamnde ɗi dabre: Dume haani waɗugo ɓelau ha debbo reedujo on?
Ƴamre tataure: Dume haani raɓɓu tugo hefta nyau dum?
Ƴamre Nayabre: Irin lekki kiye haani nyaudiramo?
Ƴamre Joyabre: ira Nyamdu nduye o woɗoto, nden bo ira ngendam dayeejam haani o hutira?
model_answer: Debbo o foti waɗde ko yaawi e yahde opitaal ngam ƴeewndaade doktoor, o waawaa fuɗɗa nyamde lekki aadaaji (herbs) hay gooto. Nde tawno o woodi koode reedu ɗiɗi ɓennuɗe (C-section), nyamde lekki aadaaji ɗaminiiɗo ko ɗum waawata addande reedu makko werngude (uterine rupture) ɗum noon ko ɗum ɗon bonnita nguurndam makko e ɓingel ngel. Gauna e nder reedu makko e ndeeɗoo dental ko maande hulɓinde nde tawno ko ɗum waawi wonde caɗeele e nder reedu, ɗum noon opitaal tan woni nokku ɗo o heɓata safaa moƴƴo. Ko ƴeewnde doktoor e ultrasound tan ngam reende nguurndam maɓɓe, tee o foti jibina ɗum e opitaal so tawii o dañii ɗum, ɗum wonaa e suudu.

question: Jam ɓandu likita waddi bingal amin larin no o fofata ɗon woni bana sautu hendu ɗo sala babal petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo dake o fofata milliti bo balɗe tati jotta o ɗo ɗotta be jamma wakkati fere mi ɗo lara ɓe ɗo nasta sosai. Ɗo sosai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako seto o naftira sembe mako o hokkata mi lari bo o wala nyama banani to o nyamai fu sauto nyamai fu sau to o nangi pofɗe mako seto nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokka tame oɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer: Alamaaji ɗii ɗon holla ɓingel maɗo ɗon mari caɗe ɓernde mawɗe, ko wayi no ñawu ƴiiƴam (pneumonia) maa asma. Ɓernde makko ɗo ƴellotoo les (chest in-drawing), o ɗon fofa saɗti, kadi o waawata ñaamugo, ɗum ɗon holla ko ñawu mettuɗum ɗo chemist waawata safraugo. Ko yaajii, ƴeewtow mo opitaal ngam o heɓata oksijen, lekki henndu (nebulizer), e lekki nder ƴiiƴam (IV) ngam hisnugo nguurndam makko. Ñawu nguu ɗon ɓeydoo mettugo kadi o ɗon ŋakkirka ñamri, ɗum noon toppitagol opitaal ɗon mari nafoore mawnde jooni. Hoto ɗon njokka rokkude mo lekki galleeji kesi, opitaal ko tan woni ko nafata ngam hisnude mo e oon sahaa.

question: Goɗɗo ɓe nodeta suberu duɓi mako sappan ɗe joyi nyande mum fere o fuddi nyouru arande bo yori ɗum nyadai amma de ɗum fabi asawai je sedda tan yarugo lebbi be hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum hallobi sedda sai ɗum salda rimopde ɗum gonga on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata inde ko nyauru ɗon satai amma. Pat manju ɗum wadai da ha nu o nyaɗita yonru de o hilliti dow o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha nyaudo o yawto o yokki nyaurde o hecci ɓe ɗo jalibi tati ko sali o lori fahin o hecci ɓe o hafti ko o wawata waɗugo bana ko himɓe shawari mo ko larani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum. Ɗo heɓe lekki ɗuɗi ka ko o suɗi da ha nuno o nyaɗita sei nyouru wari tullitti ɗum yottike wakkati fere fu mahe salda roɗi sei o nyami nyautawo on ko waɗi nyoru ɗum neɓuri bana ni salo yamɗetugo o yidi o anda ko waɗi dabare be leɗɗe ɗe o fuɗi fu nafi. oyam ɗume o wannata yoru ɗon yamɗita ɗo fu maru gam o heɓa o fufa no hani olollita jamu bandu makko.
reference:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma  de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha  Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki  Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali.  O lori  fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani  o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
model_answer: Nyouru nguu ɓurata jibineede ko sabu bakteeriyam (bana Staphylococcus) walla ko gonga lampa (cyst) jiibilindi nder ɓanndu mako, ɗum noon ko ɗum sabaɗata ɗum yaltude so ɗoftaaka haa e ɗoɗɗu. Omo haani yahde sapparal ngam ƴeewtaade sample makko (laboratory) ngam heɓde lekki peewnutiɗo, walla waɗde opereeji laaɓtuɗi ngam ɗofta gonga on haa e ɗoɗɗu. Ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam ɓuuɓɗam ina nafra deeƴnude mette ɗee, kono ñaamde goro (kola nut) wonaa ñawbu, ɗum noon omo haani woppude ɗum. Omo haani kadi laaɓtude ɓanndu makko e comci makko, kadi ƴeewndaade ƴiiƴam makko (sukara) ngam daɗndude ko ɗum addantaa. E waɗde ɗuum fow e les njiimaandi doktoor, o heɓay ñawbu timmuɗo o woppata ñawu nguu, o artira e cellal e jam.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer: Ko ɓuri heewde wadde rufgo iyam balɗe caggal danygo ko ɓawngal (placenta) ɗam accaama nder reedu, walla reedu nduu accaali momtude hoore mun (uterine atony), walla ɗum ko ɓaktuungal nder reedu (infection). Sibiti ɗo, dokajo ene hokka leɗɗe ngam wallitde reedu nduu taaqaade ngam ɗaɓɓude iyam (ko wayi no Oxytocin), ɓe ɗaɓɓirta ko heddii e nder reedu, ɓe hokka mo iyam (blood transfusion) walla leɗɗe njamndi ngam artirde semte mako. Ɗum ko nyawu tooñaɗo no feewi, ɗum noon dada oo ina haani e teeŋtinde yaawnude hootde sibiti ngam ƴeewteede, tawa ko ɗum waawi waddude hattan e nguurndam. Wonande ɓingel ngel, so yumma mum ƴeewtaama o artiraama semte, ina moƴƴi o ɗaɓɓa ƴamde yumma mum so tawii ko leɗɗe ɗe dokajo hokki yumma ɗe njahrata e ƴamde. Dada oo ina haani ñaamdu ɓuri heewde njamndi e ko waawi heɓtude semte (ko wayi no kosam e ƴi'e) ngam wallitde cellal mum e ɓingel ngel, kono ñaawoore dokajo ko ko ɓuri teeŋtude e ɗaɓɓude caɗe ɗee.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer: Alamaaji ɗen cifata ko rafi baawɗo tiiɗnude no feewi, ko wayi no malariya ɓurndo tiiɗde (severe malaria) walla ñawu ngaandi (meningitis), nguaddi ɗum ŋakkere ƴiiƴam (anemia) e ɓuuɓri gite. Omo haani yaade e opitaal ngam ƴeewndirde ƴiiƴam no feewi ngam anndude sabaabu rafi o, tee ƴeewde so tawii omo haani ƴettude ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) sabu ŋakkere ƴiiƴam ndee. Ngam dartinde ɓuuɓde, doktoor ina waawi hokkude mo leɗɗe ko wayi no metoclopramide walla ondansetron hade makko jogaade ɓernde mettude. So tawii ko malariya walla ñawu nguu tawaama e ƴeewndorɗe ɗee, doktoor maa hokku mo ɓuuɓnugol (injection) ko wayi no artesunate ngam safrude ɗum e nder reedu. Woppu hokkude mo leɗɗe keertuɗe tawa ko e les njiimaandi doktoor, tee accu mo wona ko e les toppitagol safaara ngo yaajata.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. reference:

To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. model_answer: Ɗum goonga, jokkere gorko e debbo e nder balɗe reedu weeɓaani, wadataa rafeta walla jibina ɓiɗɗo mo o nanta sabu reedu e ndiyam reedu ngartenaa ɓiɗɗo on. Alamaaje reedu ɗe keɓata ko waasude lewru, heeggol walla ñamlu, muñɗe ɗoŋɗe, e heewde yaltugol lumo. So tawii ko kulol walla ƴiiƴam caggal jokkere, ko yaawi yahde asibiti ngam doktoor ƴeewta ko boni, kono ɗum fotaani ko jokkere ɗee ngaddi rafeta. E nder reedu nguufe, jokkere ina waawi waɗeede so tawa doktoor alaa ko hañii, haa teeŋti noon ko e fuɗɗoode e cakkital reedu. So tawii ko e nder lewru cakkitiindu walla so tawii ko ƴiiƴam walla caɗe goɗɗe woodi, ko ɗoftirde jokkere ɗee ngam reende cellal debbo oo e ɓiɗɗo on.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
reference:
Jam bandu, miwari gam miniko am , mi laari ni giteji be balli mako do wadi jallo jallo ni. Kuma bani mai ni har kusan balle tati. Bandu mabbe bo do vuli odolla be zaszabi. Bo kuma be wawata yamugo, be wawata jogugo kodume fu haa redu. Bo be do duwna be do sommi wala sembe. Gam hore mabbe do regga, do naawa, be bandu mabbe do wuli. Min godi nafturugo hundeji min mari ha saare, amma wala ko changi sam be damata be. Giteji mabbe be balli mambe je changi colo jallo do har jotta dillai, do bedda beddugo tan kullum, be wala der jam, be yamdai. Bedo yara bone. Kanjum wadi Allah haddu , bedo nana bone sosai.
Kanjum wadi mi wari sibiti heba min handa komin taakata, heba bandu miniko am, balli be giteji je wadata jallo do hachai be haunai.
model_answer: Alamaaji ɗii hono zazzabi, mette e gite e nderde, ɓanndu mettugo, e ko gite ɗe waɗata jalo (jaundice), ɗum hollata ko waawi heɓtude ɓe rafi bana Lassa fever, Yellow fever, walla Malaria tiiɗɗo. Ko haanji ɗaccude huuwtinirgo leɗɗe galleeji ɗe mari hasare ɗee njooni, sabu ko ɗe waawi ɓeydude bonnugo nganndu (liver) ɗo ko ɗum warata ko jalo e gite. Ɓe poti ƴeewteede saɗtaagal to sibiti ngam ƴeewndaade ƴiiƴam (blood test) ngam anndude ko woni rafi on, ɓe ndokkee ndiyam ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) e Paracetamol ngam ustude zazzabi. So tawii ko Lassa fever, ko haani seerndude ɓe e yimɓe feere ngam haɗde mboro oo saaktude, tawa kalla ɗo mari semmbe waɗata. So ko Malaria walla rafi feere, doktoor en ɗon waawi rokkude ɓe safaa bana Artemether ngam wallitde ɓe heɓugo cellal, Allah jonnin on.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. reference:

model_answer: Nyau nguu ko mettuɗum no feewi, ina waawi wonde ƴiiƴam loowdi (sepsis) walla nyau nder qebe ɗo ƴiiƴam yaltata (bano HSP walla dysentery), ɗum noon ina ɗaɓɓi yaawgol mawnungol. Ɓingel ngel ina ɗaɓɓi safaa to opitaal tawa ko doktoor toppitii ɗum, ko wayi no rokkude ndiyam nder vena (drip), leɗɗe ngam foofde bakteri, e ƴiiƴam so tawii ina haani. Leɗɗe galleeji walla jeejibaaji ɗii mbaawataa ñamminde ɗum, ɗe keewi kadi ko ɓeydude mette ɗe. Yo ɓe njalto saawu to opitaal ngam waɗde testaji ƴiiƴam e mboro qebe ngam anndude ko woni caɗe ɗe ngam haɗde maayde. Ko yaawgol yahde opitaal tan ko ngol hisnay ɓingel ngel e ndeeɗoo nyau mettuɗum.

model_answer:
Ɓingel ngel e neene mum poti ƴeewteede ko yaawi to asibiti mawɗo, sabu ɓingel ngel salii wurtinde musungo, alaa semmbe, e ŋakkude ñaamde ko maandeeji caɗeele mawɗe hona fawde nder reedu walla ƴiiƴam (sepsis). 
Min poti ndartinoo riga ɗum tawo haa ɓingel ngel yaltu e caɗeele ɗee, sabu rokkude ɓingel ngel mo alaa moƴƴere riga waɗata ko ɓuri moƴƴinde. 
Patere ɓanndu debbo on ƴeew-ɗaa caawol ƴiiƴam (BP) e ƴiiƴam e nder safa (urine) ngam anndude so alaa ko ƴiiƴam ƴellitii (preeclampsia), hay nde tawno ko patere lewnduru woodi ɓaawo danygol. 
Tiiɗno neldu ɓe to doktoor ɓiɗɗo (pediatrician) walla opitaal mawɗo ngam ƴeewde ɓingel ngel no fotiri, ko wayi no ƴeewndo X-ray walla rokkude safrooje ngam wurtinde musungo. 
E ɗoon e ɗoon, hisnu ɓingel ngel ngam ɓuuɓde e etaade wadde ñaamde ɗo waawi ngam wallitde ngurndan maggal haa ɓe mbaawa heɓde safrugol.

question: Debbo danyi ɓingel ɓingel lewru mai lewru jui waɗi bayani hala ɓingel mai o viya damuwa dow ɓingel mai wakkati o dal mai ɗo musina sosai bana no handi. Debbo dayi bingel. Bingel mai leuru jew ko saali. Owadi bayani hala bingel mai, ovi wala damuwa do bingel mai wakati odayi mo, bingel mai do musina sosai bana no haadi,  bani tan o laari bingel mai do wooka naudum ha juude be kostejimako.

model_answer: Ndee ɗo ko ɓernde juuroore (inguinal hernia) ɗo nderji ɓalli njippata haa e wosre ɓingel on, ɗum waɗi o ina metta no feewi wakkati o ɗammina. Hasiyuugo colli walla ɗoftaare ɗoftooje ngam fooftaade ɗum ko haɗaaka sabu alaa ko njoɓata tee waawi addude nderji ɗii ɓuuɓde (strangulation) ko ɗum bonna cellal ɓingel. Nyawu on ko opereeji (surgery) tan ngam woppude ɓernde ndee, ɗum ɗaɓɓirta yahde to sibiti to doktoor opereeji (surgeon) woni. Ɗum noon, ɗaɓɓanane addane ɓingel on to sibiti ɓurɗo sosaade seeɗa hade caɗeele ɗee ɓeydaade. Toon ɓe mbaɗanay mo opereeji ɗii ko reena mo wuurde tawa ko e cellal.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. model_answer: Zazzibi mawɗo, nawol hore, e ɓuuɓri ɗe ɗon ƴellita ɓanndu makko ɗon hollira nyau mawɗe bana malaria, typhoid, walla ko ɗum ɓeyda waɗde ko allergie dow lekki injection ɗo ɓe mbaɗi mo. Ko himmunde, o dartoto okkude mo kala lekki ɗo ɓe mbaɗata mo, o foti yo o adda mo to opitaal (saawirde) ko yaawi ngam doktoor waɗa ƴeewndo ƴiiƴam (blood test) ngam heɓude safaa mo yaarunooka. Nde o woni e yahde opitaal, o waawa ɓuuɓnude ɓanndu makko e ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam ngam ustude zazzibi o, e ndokkude mo ndiyam keewɗam yaruude. Wuro okku mo lekki keso kala tawa ko doktoor yamirtaa, nde tawnoo ɗum waawi ɓeydude allergie ɗo ɓuuɓri ɗe ɗon ƴellita ɓanndu makko. Nyau ngun ko ngo metti no feewi, ɗum waɗi ɗaɓɓude cellal to opitaal ko yaawi ko luumtirteeɗe ngam daɗndude nguurndam makko.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. model_answer: Ko ɗuum ko waawi waɗde e rafi o: ko ɓuuɓri muusuɗo (pneumonia), TB, walla asma, nde tawno ko ɓuuɓri (cough), naange (fever), e fa'naare henndu ɗe njalti ko lekki galleeji safrataa. No woniri ɗuum, ko haani yo o jokkude e sibitaa ngam waɗde foto nder ɓalndu (chest X-ray) e ƴeewndorde kammu (sputum test) ngam hoolkisaade ko feewti e TB walla ɓuuɓri. So ko asma walla ɓuuɓri, ko leɗɗe ɗe ɓuuɓnata henndu (inhalers) walla antibiyotik (antibiotics) ɗe doktoor yamiri ko poti huutoreede ngam ustude ɗuum. Huutoraade lekki galleeji ɗii e rafi teeŋtuɗo ko njiyaani tan, ɗum waɗata ko rafi o ɓeyda bonde. Ɗum waɗata, acca mo o woppa lekki galleeji ɗii, o jokku e sibitaa haa o ƴeewtaake no feewi o heɓa safaara ko moƴƴi.

question: Mini amodai we'e anɓɓa he jo jonamo o warti wuro o wulla, kominma ko fetiyam bosaru ha kosɗe mako me kala bo saru on toi ɗum ɗuroi koɗum bosaru kindiraɓe on wakkati nden meban ha balbe bo salun nga timmo ngam ɗum warake bo saru. mi yarama asibiti danyu dare kindira bate den tan mi yaha mi soda ha kemis mi sodi bata on ɗum tufuma ɗum kenya illa wakkati den mi yarima wuro amma lake man umti nokkure nanwoji jotta kam hakkila ammi hemi tammi bo sare ɗon hokki ɓingel nyamdu bo sare. mido nyama wodi lekki combiti larugo ko mo.

Illa wakkati den, mi yarimọ wurọ amma illa ƙeƴa , futtẹrẹ man ɓuuti , nọgurẹ nọ wooji. Jotta kam ,hakkilo am  ummi  ẹ mi tammi boosaru dun hokki ɓingel am nƴau boosaru. model_answer: Ɓuuɓri ndii wonande e nder reedu, haa teeŋti e juuɗe e koyɗe, nde wondude e ƴiiƴam toowɗam (BP), ina hollira caɗeele mawɗe biyeteeɗe preeclampsia, ɗe mbaawi warde yumma e ɓingel. Kuutoragol lekki wuro ko wayi no "combiti larugo" ko weeɓnaani e nder reedu, sabu ina waawi bonnude ɓingel walla addude jibineede ko yaawi. Alaa e sango o yah to asibitee jooni ngam ƴeewde ƴiiƴam makko e ƴeewndo urine, tawa o jokkii e ƴettude lekki asibitee ɗii o woppaaki lekki wuro ɗii. Woppude lekki asibitee ɗii ko bonnata cellal maɓɓe, tee ina waawi addude caɗeele wuyɗe ɗe mbaawataa fiyde. Laawol gootol tan ngam hisnude nguurndam maɓɓe ko huutoraade safaara laaɓɗo e les njiimaandi doktoor haa reedu nduu yaltu.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Bo o ɗo ɓeddi ɓandu seɗɗa wakkati fere o ɗo fiya o ɗo lara daure o wala lara boɗɗum to o ummi o ɗo wanca mirliti o ɗo silla akai be ɗuɗɗum bo ɗume on watata sendugo. Ɗo be ɗonka ɗo kwaɗi o yarata ndiyam ɗuɗɗum denbo o ɗo silla ɗuɗɗum ko alamaji ɗo wawan je yahu shuga ko hundeji fere ɗon aunugo be ko ji waɗata heɓa hefta irin nyautoy ɗon ɗo ko waɗi o ɗo somi kullum ɗo ɗume on waddata silugo akay ɗo. Ɗo sembe iyam mako ɓamti ɗon waɗata nyauɗo ko ndiyam ɓandu mako timmina ko kuje fere ɗon tan irin nyiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma ɗume on handi o dinga nyamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji ɗo de handi noi be hollugo je shuga handi waɗa kullum ko. Yonde go nyau toi ɗon waɗata alamaji ɗo je feɗata ha ɓandu mako.

model_answer: Ee, alamaji ɗo o yara ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, o wanca ɗum ɗuɗɗum, e o wattata, ko ɗe alamaji nyau shuga (diabetes), amma njaram boɗeejo ɗum e caɗe nder ɓalli ɗon waawi holla kadi nyau Filiariasis walla nyau njaram (UTI) ɗe ɗon heewa waɗugo e nyauɓe shuga. Ɗum waɗi o foti yahde opitaal ngam waɗugo ƴeewngo ƴiiƴam (blood sugar test) e ƴeewngo njaram (urinalysis) ngam tabitinde ko ɗum woni nyau ngun. To ɗum nyau shuga, o ƴetta leɗɗe ɗe doktoor ndokki bana metformin walla insulin, o acca ñaamdu ɗe ɗuuɗi suukara bana ƴi'e e ɗokku. O ɓeyda ñaamugo ɗi ɗoƴƴuɗi bama kosam, diggol, e purƴi ngam wallude cellal ɓalli, tawa o ƴeewta ɓalli makko ɗuuɗuka. Kadi, o laɓɓina caɗe ɗe nder ɓalli makko e ndiyam sabulu o doga kuɗe ngam reena ɗum en ɓeyngude mawnude.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
reference:
Reedujo wari sibiti kikide do, sai ovi gorko mako do hoolinaamo akai akai be do doofa mo kullum. Ovi do watimo odinga hurtuluggo. Yalaade dumdum to onani gorko mako do warta saare ko to onangan lawol sare, se odo hurtila gam odo daami ta o tappamo ko o huda mo.
O hirliti fuu berde mako do dogga, do fi’ya. O dilli haunugo sembe eyam mako, se tawi do fa’i.
 Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata.  Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.
Oyidi o anda, dume don o wadata heba ta oringa hurlituko sosai do, to odo hota sare ko to o nani gorko mako do warta? 
Dume don owadata o lornina  hakkilo mako, berde mako waala , jam e hakkilo?
model_answer: Reedujo on ɗon mari lornina hakkilo e kulol ɗe ɗon addana mo ƴiiɓam ɗo e mette nder reedu, ɗum ko ɗaɓɓa ƴeewngo saawra to sibiti ngam hisnude nguurndam maako e ɓiɗɗo on. Ɓii'ude ƴiiɓam ɗo o heɓata ɗo ɗon ɗaɓɓa ƴeewngo doktoor rewɓe e ƴeewndirde ultrasound to sibiti, o acca ɗum huutortoo lekki gargajiya ɗin bawo ɗi mbaawaa dartinde caɗeele ɗen. Kulol e mette ɗe gorko maako naddata ɗum ɗon ɓeyda caɗeele ɓernde, ɗum ko ɗaɓɓa o ɗaɓɓa ballal doktoor ngam ƴeewndirde hakkillo maako (counseling) ngam wallitde mo heɓde jam. Ko ɓuri teeŋtude ko yo o artu sibiti saawra yaajɗa ngam ƴeewteede ngam heɓde safaa'e potɗe ɗe ƴellitirta cellal makko e jam hakkillo maako.

model_answer: Ɓingel maa on ɓullata ko ɓuri heewde sabi o fuɗɗiima ñaamde ñaameteeɗi ko ɗum yaajnoo e duuɓi tati, kono ɓullugol ngol no haawniri (projectile) ina waawi wonde ko e nyaw reedu ko wayi no pyloric stenosis. question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
reference:
Daada je wondi ha daadirabe je waddata bikkoi mappe tufugo baatal ofamtini  o ye’u kecchel mako do mari damuwa ha hundeko mako, bo lebol mingel mai o wadi buluu .
Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.
Dumedon watata lebol mingel wada buluu banni? Dume don kuma waddata mingel torra bo heba damuwa foofugo to’ do musina? Lekki don be hokkatanaaa, ko be larai mingel mai na?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel rafa rafi bonɗo no feewi ko wayi no ñawbuuli ɓernde (cerebral malaria) walla ƴiiƴe ɓernde (meningitis), ɗum noon alaa e sago ñaawo defte aadaaji ɗe ko wayi no cutugol ɗaɗe walla ɓuuɓnude ɗe, ɗe nana ɓeyda bonnude nguurndam makko. Ɓooygol ɗam (bulu) ina holla ɓingel ngel alaa butel (oxygen) e nder ɓanndu, ɗum noon ina poti yahde e safrirde (hospital) jooni ngam ɗaɓɓude cafrirɗe. Dammle ɗe e nder hunduko ina gasa tawa ko ɗe ngaddi ɗum sabu cutugol ɗaɗe ɗe njuɓɓini walla ko ñawu ngu ko wayi no ñawu ƴiiƴe (oral thrush). E nder safrirde, ɓe ɗokka mo butel, ñemre ngam dartinde kammu, e leppi ko wayi no antimalarial walla antibiotics ngam safrude ñawu nguu. Woppu rokkude mo leɗɗe galleeji, sabu ko safrirde tan woni ko waawi hisnude nguurndam ɓingel ngel e haɗde mboro o yahde e hoore.

O foti jokkude ƴamde leɗɗe ɗe doktoor darni ɗen haa timma, e ƴaltinde ƴam ɗam e juuɗe mum walla e ƴam-reedu (breast pump) ngam haɗde ɓuuɓri nduu. question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.

Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako.

model_answer: Ee, ko himmude no feewi yo ɓe njah to asibiti tawa ko jooni, sabu ko ñawu ngul ko wayi no ñawu nguleendi nder hoore (cerebral malaria) walla ñawu ƴiiƴam (meningitis). Gila e humpito am bana doktoor haa lesdi Afirika, alamaaji ɗii bana ɓanndu wulde, mboro (convulsions), e majjere hakkille ko ɗum laarani ñawbuji mawɗi ɗi mbaawi warde ɓingel ngel so tawiino heɓaali safaara ko yaawi ko wayi no leɗɗe nder ɗalngal (IV). Baaba ɓingel ngel alaa e sago woppo tawo ɓingel ngel ina waasaa hakkille, o foti ko yo o naw mo to doktoor ngam heɓde safaara sahaa kala. Kuutoragol leɗɗe galleeji walla leɗɗe gaadanteeje e ndeen sahaa ko ɗum bonnata haala kaa, tawa ko safaara doktoor to asibiti tan waawi hisnude nguurndam ɓingel ngel. To asibiti, doktoor maa ƴeewndo ƴiiƴam (blood tests) ngam ƴeewde ñawu nguleendi walla ñawu nguu fof, o hokka mo safaara ko yaawi ngam hisnude nguurndam makko.

Eɗa poti waɗde ƴeewndo ƴakkere ngam anndude sitta, o hokka leɗɗe ƴiiɓre e ɗe ustata ɓuuɓri ko yaawi. Ngam muñɗe ɗemngal makko, hokka mo leɗɗe pamarel ñemmbitorɗe ngam ustude mette ɗee, ɗum wallita mo yaawde ñaamde. Ndokku mo ndiyam ƴettuɗam e ORS ngam haɗa ɗum yoorde, kadi ndarto jogaade mo e asbiti ngam reende caɗeele ɗe mbaawi aroyde e nder hoore makko. Eɗa poti jogaade deeƴre, tawa ko e toppitagol moƴƴol o waawi yaawde moƴƴineede, o hoota e fiyde e sakiraɓe makko.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
reference: Debbo mo dubi cappande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali. Dayugo mai daidai don. Amma dai be dayi mingel do, mingel do do Mari damuwaaji manga. Mingel do Wala wooka boddum. Denbo wala nootititta bana kejjel wadata. Bawo dayugo bingel mai wookai  boddum bo do hebba bone ha finigo. Bandu bingel mai do bana do tiddi ko kuma bana walaa dimba no haadi. Bingel mai wala yaama boddum be torna mo musunungo. Daada mai do sakli gam bikkoiji mako de saali do bedo wooka, ataake to be dayibe . Dume don waddata damuwa do? Goji toi be wadata do kechel do, be kuma mataaki gwagaawal toi hosata? Dumedon wannata mingel kejjum do?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko hattande ƴiiƴam heewɗam caggal danygol, ko noon ɓingel ngel e yumma mum poti seerdeede; ɓoggol ngol (umbilical cord) ina foti sëreede (clamp) e taƴeede e laawal cellal ngam hisnude ɓingel ngel e caɗeele ɗee. 
Ɓoggol ngol wota ƴoggire e doole sabu ɗum yaafataa yaltinde dango ngoo, tee ko ɗum tooñata ɓingel ngel bana no o heɓi ƴaañgol nii. 
Yumma oo ina haani hokkeede ndiyam ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) e leɗɗe bana Oxytocin walla Misoprostol ngam wallitde reedu nduu dartinde ƴiiƴam ɗam e yaltinde dango ngoo. 
So dango ngoo yaltinaako ko yaaji, doktoor ina foti waɗde njaltugol juuɗe (manual removal of placenta) e nder suudu nyawndeeje ngam haɗa asmaaji baawɗi warde. 
Titorde e ƴaañgol ɗe ɓingel ngel heɓi ɗee, ina haani ƴeewteede ko yaaji e juuɗe gollooɗo cellal ngam tabitinde balɗe mum caggal danygol (APGAR) e rokkude mo safaara potɗo.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
reference:
Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.
Sai minvi debbo mai o umma o hoods obaara bawo mako , heba vallita bandu mako hoina sedda da pat ba, amma vallitai bo gite mako Labai. Min sauri mo to yamini sai oyara paracetamol. To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
model_answer:
Debbo o ina mari nyaw reedu e ƴiiƴam caggal jibgol (sepsis) e malariya tiiɗɗo, ko ɗum waɗi gite makko ɗe ƴeeɓi (jaundice). 
Omo haani neldireede opitaal mawɗo ko yaawi ngam heɓde leɗɗe nder ƴiiƴe (IV drip) hono antibiyotik e artesunate, tawa ko kuɗe (tablets) tan mbaawataa safrude ɗuum. 
Wajjitii waɗde mo ƴeewndo ƴamarre (blood test) e ƴeewngo reedu ngam humpitaade ko addani parasitaaji ɗii njokkude e nguleendi ɓanndu. 
Jaɓgol nyamnude mo kuɗe seeɗɗe e wakkati o ɗon mari caɗeele e ƴiiƴam nii, waawaa moƴƴitinde mo kono ina waawi bonnude nguurndam makko. 
Ngam reende nguurndam makko ngam wallude sukaaɓe makko tato, accittoo neldude mo opitaal ngam safrugol jaajugol.

question: Dana kesum ko danya e ha asibiti amen minti cappanɗe ɗiɗi ko waɗi ɓingel waɗi nuɗum danyi woya woya teli nude danya ngel wadai woyade boɗɗum min yiwi fu nanugo mako tidum no bingel delabi tan mi yiwi kadi tamreji mako tidum no alai nalle mako ko dume. Ɓingel kesum waɗi danyi ha ɗa'i waɗa de boɗɗum gele danya harnuje jamu wala doraja. Ɓingel foti heɓɗe e nati wuro ɓingel ko ɗume o wawi kokkude ɓingel ti ko ɗume o wawa hokkude ha irin nyau. ma nyamana enjamgel ma waɗi enjam.
reference:
Binge danyel kesum ko danyaa e ha asbiti amen minti cappande didi ko wadii , Binge Ngel ena wadi no dum  daanii  woori. Tawi gila node daya, Ngel wadaayi woyaade boddum . Min yeewii  numfuaango maako, 
tee dum no waddu . Kono bingel ngel ena nyibi tan . Min yeewii kadi tembereeji maako, tee dum no alaa cedeele. Naamnal am ko :ko dume waawi waddi bingel  kesum wadi no dum daanii haa  woori e wadaayi wodaade boddum gile nde danyaa?
Hol nooje njamu walla jokkondiral ngel bingel nge foti hebde?
inna o arti  wuro e bingel ngel, kodume o waawii hokkude bingel ngel, tee kodume o waawaa hokkude?
Hol irin nyamuduuji inna maa nyaamde ngam o Wonaa e jam, tee bingel ngel maa wadi e jam?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ina wondi e caɗeele yaafde e wuumde (hypothermia), ko ɗuum waɗi ko haani ko yaawi wuttude mo e wutte wuurɗe walla naatnude mo e nder incubator ngam ɓamtude mo. Hokku mo henndu (oxygen) walla ballal yaafde (PPV) so o accaani yaafde no feewi, kadi laaɓtin laawol henndu makko so tawii ko ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam (meconium) nguli. Ɗaɓɓir ƴiiƴam makko ngam ƴeewde sukar (glucose), hokku mo antibiyotik hono Ampicillin e Gentamicin, haa e tuubaare ɗam ndiyam (IV fluids) ngam wallitde semmbe makko. So o naatii suudu ɓiɗɓe, ko haani ko ƴeewaake nguleendi makko, ƴiiƴam makko, e yaafde makko ballogal ngam reende ɓamtal makko. Yumma o heɓa inɗe (oxytocin) ngam wallitde ƴiiƴam makko, o fuɗɗora reende ɓingel ngel so tawii o selli.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
reference:
Daada dayi chekkel saati didi ko saali do. Ofuddi larugo eyam sedda sedda ha bandumako . Amma baldeji odilla ni, olari hundeji ko nandi reedu be eyam do vurta. Wakati feere daada bingel mai do changi. Debbo daade mako ko omari vodai. Denbo o handi daada bingel do odo mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha les jaaburu mako. Bo kullum to olaari alaamaji do berde mako do sakla. Odo tampi ko irin damuwaaji do nonnon fedata bawo dayugo ko damuwa fere don. Don yedde je o yahi sibiti, be odo volla be daadiraabe fere, sai o Nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fedata ha bandu mappe. Kanjum waddi mo odi olaara likita ovolwina be.
Demde am dume donwaddata irin hundeji do bawo dayugo? Waawan nawugo les reedu alaama ye’u don na?
Alaamaji toi daada kesum haadi wata hakkilo bawo dayugo? Mataaki toi daada do haadi tokka heba ta ye’u do heba mun?
model_answer: Nafa ɗum o tampata sahaa ɓiɗɗo on nana ko nafa potɗo (afterpains) sabu ɓamtaare oxytocin nde wadata ko mawninde reedu haa nde woppata ɓural ngal. Kono yaltugol ko ƴiye wano kosam ɗam, ina haani o waɗa 'ultrasound scan' reedu ngam ƴeewtude so tawii ko heddiiɓe reedu (retained placenta) walla ko ɓoggol ƴiiƴam potngam. Nafa ɗum o woppata les ɗerewol makko ko no njahrata e reedu nde woppata ko ɗum kadi ko nafa potɗo. O foti jokkude yarbude leɗɗe ɗe doktoor on dotti ɗam, so wonaa tawa ina woodi ƴiiƴam ɓurngo tatiika, ɓuuɓri mawndi walla ko huɗo bonɗo ummotoo. Ɗaɓɓitaneeɗo on waɗa yo o yillo doktoor ngam ƴeewndeede e waɗde scan ngol ngam hoolkisaade cellal makko timmungal.

question: Debbo fere kam waddi bingel mako mo dimbi tati asibiti be laramo hande subaka ko be halibo eketo yimɓe olo wani binge on tatata kosam o larata goddo fere mo wolwal tamo heddi inde mako o sota mo damai ha noi masan hingare jungo nyami debbo on cokali on medi hiɓugo badde na mako. O meda himɓe baɗɗe minbedi men cokali heɓi jaɓugo kala batel mum ha tummude ko o fotti noɓugo bana no inna mako waddi redi nyaudugo ɗum min kotoltol laɓii mingew on jarbi bate mako pat feiti. Innde cukali on ingol wala paɗɗe o jaɓi bate pesode mako pat ko dami cu.
reference:

Ko ɓe halibo, ike tọ ƴiɓẹ wolwani ɓingei on,o tonta takọ sam, ọlarata gọdọ fẹrẹ mo wọlwatamọ,e ta nọdi indẹ makọ ,ọsọŋata,mọ damai   hanọ ọnai naima sam.

model_answer: Innde nyau man ko "darnde nder ɓogu" (neonatal intestinal obstruction), ko wayi no nyau Hirschsprung walla caɗe ɗo ɓogu gasata (anorectal malformation). Alamaaji mayre ko waasde yaltinde kosam geec nder balɗe ɗiɗi jibineede, fuɗde/mawnude jsongo, e ƴii'ude ko boɗeeje geec (bilious vomiting). Toppitagol jaatiinngol ngol ko dartina ñamri e reedu (NPO), ɗoɗɗude tuubo nder reedu (nasogastric tube) ngam yaltinde ko ɗo yaari, e rokkude ndiyam ƴiiƴam (IV fluids). Tawi noon, ko haanji no feewi yaawde neldude ɓingel ngel to doktoor ƴamɗe (surgeon) ngam waɗde opereeji ngam feewnude ɗum e hisnude nguurndam maggel.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.
reference:
Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
model_answer: Eey, ɗuum ko feere moƴƴere e safrugol makko nde tawno o waawaa jogaade meɗe feɗugo (ORS) sabu ko o rufata kala. Rokkude mo darnata iyam (IV fluids) ko yaaji ko himmende no feewi ngam artirde ndiyam nder ɓanndu e hisnude yonki makko. Poti rokkude mo kadi bateji (injections) ngam daɗndude rufgol ngol, e lekkiji ngam safrude 'puseni' (ƴeewndo reedu) walla rufgol 'redu' (ƴiiƴam) so tawii ko ɗuum o mari. Ɗuum fof ko laawol potngol ngam safrude ŋakkere ndiyam e mboro ko wayi no gastroenteritis. Kono doktoor ina poti jokkude ƴeewnda mo ngam tabitnde ko fijata ɗum, haa e ƴeewnude ƴiiƴam makko ngam rokkude mo safrugol ngo moƴƴi.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.
reference:
Alabukun vii,  odo ye’a dowre , kanjum be chomri, bo hore naawata mo do hadi mo jode belde. Saati didi ko salli, o wala naaana jamma boddum sam. Koste mako didi be juude mako be yeso fu pat ni do puuti puuti. Odo tani habda be mai. Be saurimo o yara hundeji fere nii, amma dai fu pat walaa ko hoini sam. Amma nii be viimo o tammi waddugo daama.
Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100.  Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai  watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta  ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?
Be kuma dume don jaumu redu wadata da yotta irinbanni bako owonna banni?
model_answer: Dabare ɗe kaalto-ɗaa ɗen, bana futugol ɓanndu fu, hoore ɗoygol, e ŋakkere ƴiiƴam, hollata ko o mari caɗe niɓɓe (kidney failure) walla caɗe ɓernde ɗe mbaɗata ɗam mooftugo nder ɓanndu. Ŋakkere ƴiiƴam ɗum ko sabu niɓɓe ɗen njaltataa hormones ɗe ɗaminoo ƴiiƴam, ɗum waɗi o ɗoya haa omo waawaa semmbe, omo ñaawa ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) ngam wallugo ɓernde mako. Ko ɗum waɗi, ko yaajata o heɓa ƴiiƴam ɗam ɓe ɗon nji'a ngam ɗokkindo mo, tawa kadi omo sokli "shafi fofugo" (dialysis) ngam wurtinde ɗam ɗam ɗon ɗoƴɗina mo. Yumma maako ɗo jima ɗon mari haaje heɓugo ballal, kono omo waawi wallude ɓiɗɗo maako e jaɓugo doktoor'en ngam timminde ɗokkinde ƴiiƴam e shafi mako. Alaa lekki galle waawi safrude ɗum, ko yaajata o jokka e opitaal ngam heɓugo ƴiiƴam e "shafi fofugo" ɗi doktoor'en ɗon njuɓɓinta ngam hisnude mo.

question: Ɓawo mi dayi bandu am fuɗɗi hoinugo kirinni min dadai en wala ndiyam laɓɗam ha fattude en yiɗi mi yiwa kullum kullum ndiyam be dotti min naftirta min ma fa. reference: Bawo mi dayi , bandu am fuddi hoinugo , kikide fere ni minumi, tunde dai en wala diam labdam ha fattude amin, to idi mi yiiwa kullum kullum diam be dotti , minaftirita , mi numii amma fah haadi ni mido hakkilona hore am mido yiiwa boddum. Toh kikide fere bo wari , mi nanei beldum bandu am. Mi fuddi nanugo jaagol , be bandu am fuddi dewnugo kullum kullum . Da mido naana jaagol, bo hauti be bandu am vellai fein. Se mi hirliti eyam je vurtata bawo dayugo don hacchega mi nannata daga ton bo vellai bo. Hacchega mai duudi bo meddai fudugo be am  bo. Mi kaasi ittugo gite am daga totton. model_answer: Ɗuum ko cilol mette mawɗe ɓaawo jibingol, ko wayi no sepsis (ɓuuɓri nder ƴiiƴam), malaria, walla ɓernde mettu, sabu aɗa woya ƴiiƴam e ɓernde maa. Ɓanndu maa semteede e ƴiiƴam danyugo (anemia) ina ɓeyda caɗeele cellal maa. Ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam ɗam aɗa naftora e hoore maa waawi addande ɓuuɓri goɗɗo, kono ko mette ɗee mawɗe njaltata e nder ƴiiƴam. Aɗa haani yahde sibiti safaa e yaawre ngam ƴeewndo ƴiiƴam, heɓde leɗɗe ɓuuɓri (antibiotics), leɗɗe malaria, e rokkeede ƴiiƴam so ina haani. Kadi, ƴeew ndiyam ɗam ɓuuyna hade maa fattude, ñaam geɗe ɗe mballirta cellal, tawa ko ɗee mette poti ñifde ko leɗɗe sibiti tan.

model_answer:
Ko ɓuri teeŋude, nyau ngu ɗaɓɓataɗa on wonaa ko nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta, ko ƴiiƴam seeɗa (infantile colic), caɗeele ñamndu (allergie) walla nyau njuura (UTI) addata ɓingel ngel muñude e fofude boɗɗum. 

Alamaaji nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta ko ko wayi no koɗorɗe jeeeyeede (jaundice), ɓuuɓri kammu, e pickuge henndu; kadi, a woppa ɓamtude ɓingel ngel e doole, ɗum waawi bonnude nder ɓingel ngel. 

Waɗ ɓingel ngel koose caggal ñamndu, ɓeydu yiytude no ɓingel ngel ñamirta kosam, nde tawnoe caɗeele ƴiiƴam (colic) ko heewi woppude ko e lebbi tati haa nayi. 

Yah ɗa waddu ɓingel ngel asibiti ngam waɗde wiɗto njuura (urine test), sabu ko doktoor'en tan nganndi ko ɓuri haani hokkude nguure ɓurndu moƴƴude ngam safrude nyau ngu. 

Sarwaaɓe aadaaji mbaawataa hokkude nguure ndee, ɗum ko doktoor'en tan poti lartina nyau ngu ngam laaɓtinde caɗeele ɗe ɓingel ngel mari ɗee.

question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. model_answer: Alamaaji ɗii ko maande ɓernde teddungal e nder reedu (preeclampsia), ko nyau keewɗo waɗde e rewɓe reeduɓe tawa ko caɗeele ƴiiƴam comci (placenta) ngaddata ɓernde mawnugol e ɓuuɓri mooftugol ndiyam. Ee, nyau nguinaango nguu ina waawi bonnude cellal jom suudu e ɓiɗɗo reedu, haa teeŋti e sahaa jibineede ko adii waktu (preterm labor). Alamaji potɗi addude mo to safrirde ko yaaju ko: hareeji hoore ɗiiɗɗi, ko yiytintee e gite (blurred vision), hare ɓernde les ɓalndu, e ɓuuɓri juuroore mawnunde. E nder ñaamdu, o foti ko ñaamdu feewndu ndu proteinji e kalsiyam (nɗiyam) keewɗi, wondude e ittude lamɗam e ñameele mborosɗe ɗe ngalaa ɗoftaare. Tawa ko e lebbi jeeɗiɗi o fuɗɗii winnditde lewru e hareeji, ko laaɓti yo o yah to doktoor kala ko yaawi ngam ƴeewnde ƴiiƴam ɗam e ndaarde ɓiɗɗo oo.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer: Alamuje ɗe ka ftata ɗe ko bana ñawu hakkille, hono fuɗɗorde saasumuki (psychosis) walla moyɓere ɓernde tiiɗnde. Doktoor ɗo poti yahde ko doktoor ñawuuji hakkille (Psychiatrist), ko kanko andi nyawuji berde, o tawatee e opitaal mawɗo. O ɓamtoo ko leɗɗe (medication) ɗe mbaawata wallitde mo haa o moƴƴa, kadi o waawanɗo heɗaade caɗe maɓɓe. Yantuma njillu nguu ari, hisnu mo e nder suudu, acca ƴattaade mo, ndokku mo ñaameteeɗe e ndiyam laaɓɗam. Ñawu nguu ina waawi safreede so ndartinaama e sahaa to doktoor on.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Alamuje ɗe ɗe cifaa ko ɓuuɓri ƴiiƴam henndu (pneumonia) walla bronchiolitis, ɗum ko ñawbuuji keewɗi e sukaaɓe tokosɓe. Tari maako yaajɗo e jamma, heɓgol henndu yaawngol (fufa be lau), e coorɗe ɗeɗɗe nder ɓalndu (keccel wokan) ko sabu ɓuuɓri ndi yani e paabi ɗi henndu naatata ɗii, ko ɗum saɗtina gallol kammu. Yaawgol haalaaji ɗii ko maande ñawu nguu tiiɗii, ko ɗum waɗi ina teeŋti no feewi yaawnude yahde to safrirde ngam ƴeewde ɓingel ngel, ƴeewde hayre mum, e rokkude kammu (oxygen) so ina haani. Doktoor tan ko waawi rokkude leppi ngam hisnude ɓuuɓri ndii (antibiotics) walla leppi ballitooji udditgol paabi ɗii caggal nde o ƴeewta ɓingel ngel. Woto rokku ɓingel ngel leppi ɓurtuɗi e hoore maa, kono ndokku muumɗum ɗam ɓuuɓndam ñalawma kala ngam yaafnude paabi ɗii haa nde ɓe njaltata to safrirde.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer: Bingel ngal ina haani yaafere yaajnde e juuɗe doktoor opereeji sabu ko ɗum hernia rawandu nde caɗeele, ɗe addii vurtugol, mette, e ƴiiƴam caggade nde neɗɗo waɗi heen ko feewi e hoore mum. Ɗuum ina waawi wonde ko ƴiye ɗe njippiima (strangulation) walla ko nyawbu mawndu, ɗe noon ko yaajde haani safreede seeɗa kadi ina waawi warde bingel ngal so opereeji mbaɗaaka. Safrooɓe ɓee mbaɗa opereeji ngam feewnude ɗuum, wondude e rokkude leɗɗe nyawbu (antibiotics) ngam haɗde nyawbu ɗe ngaddi ɗum ko adii. Hernia rawandu e sukaaɓe ɓuri heewde ko ina sella hoore mum haa e duuɓi njoyo, kono golle gaaɗe (gargajiya) ina bonna ɗum tee ina addana ɗum caɗe mawɗe. Tiiɗno, ngam hisnude nguurndam bingel ngal, acca ko ɓe mbaɗata kala e hoore maɓɓe, ngam rokkude ɗum yaafere laawɗunde e nder asibiti.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Ɗum gasa ko Lassara (malaria) nangi ɓe ɗiɗo fof, kono ɓingel ngel heɓi Lassara tiiɗndu (cerebral malaria) walla mboro gonɗo e ƴiiƴaaji (sepsis), ɗum addani mo caygol hakkilo. Ɓingel ngel ina wondi e caɗeele nguurndam, ina ɗaɓɓi yo yah opitaal ɗoon e ɗoon ngam waɗde wiɗto ƴiiƴam e rokke leɗɗe ɗe ɓe mbaɗata e ƴiiƴaaji (IV). Yumma oo ina foti jokkude ƴamnde ɓingel ngel so o waawii, kono o sokla kadi wiɗto ƴiiƴam ngam anndude ko nangi mo e rokke mo safaara. E wiyde laabi cellal, zazzabi e caygol hakkilo e nder ɓingel ko ko yaawi jogaade sabu ko mboro waawi saabaade e hoore (meningitis) walla ƴiiƴaaji. Woppude ƴeewndagol ngol e safaara yaajɗo waawi addande ɓingel ngel caɗeele duumiiɗe e hoore walla maayde, ɗum waɗi yaawde yahde safrirde ko ko himoore.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: Ñawu ngu waawi wonde ko ɓuuɓri ɓalndu (eczema) walla ko jijjiingo (allergy) ngu leɗɗe ɗee e sabbulo ɓaleejo ɗon mbaɗa e ɓalndu mun. Toray, accu huutoraade leɗɗe kuuɗe ɗe e sabbulo ɓaleejo ɗii, ɗe ngoni ɓeydude ko bonnude ɓalndu mun. Loto ɓingel ngel e ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam walla sabbulo ɓuuɓɗo, caggan ɗuum huɓɓir ɓalndu mun e ko ɓuuɓata wano Vaseline ngam haɗude yoorde. Yaltu yahdu e asibiti ngam doktoor ƴeewta ɓingel ngel, o hokka mo safaara ɓalndu (topical steroid) ɗun footi ngam hisnude mo ñawu ngu.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel alaa e sago acca ɗum tawa a safrataa, sabo caɗeele ɗe duimi lebbi ɗiɗi ɗe mbaawi wonde kuura ƴiye (peptic ulcer) walla ƴiye ɓutte (worms). **Ko ɗum waɗi:**

Alamaaji ɗii ko ɓurngo hollude ko ñawu suukara ƴiiƴam (Type 1 diabetes) bee ɓeydagol ɗum caɗtuɗum (DKA - diabetic ketoacidosis), nde tawnoo ɓingel ngel ina holla peewje (polyuria), leeltaare, mawnugol teddeendi ɓanndu, e ƴiiƴam ngam daande ndiyam.

Ko haanji ƴeewde suukara ƴiiƴam rewo ɓurɗo yaawde (fingerstick glucose) — so tawii ko toowɗo ko ɓuri 200 mg/dL (11 mmol/L), ko DKA ko ɗum waɗi, ko haɗa ɗum ko musiiba.

Fuɗɗo ndiyam IV (normal saline 10-20 mL/kg e nder waktu gooto) caggal ɗuum ɓeydu insulin IV (0.1 units/kg/waktu), tawa ko e ƴeewde potaasiyom kadi fof ko e les njiimaandi cukalel ɓurngol heewde.

Neldaa ɓingel ngel ɓurɗo yaawde to opitaal mawɗo ngam toppitagol tawa ko e IV insulin, IV fluids, e ƴeewnde glucose e potaasiyom laawol gootol.

Ɗum ko haɗre cellal nde alaa ko nafata, ko haanji yaawde waɗde golle ɗe ngam hisnude nguurndam ɓingel ngel.

"Kilungo iyam" ko ɗum ɓamtaare ƴiiƴam (anemia) mawnde e ŋakkugol semmbe (shock) sabu ƴiiƴam ɗam o yottini e jibineede, kadi ina waawi wonde ɗum sibawu (sepsis) sabu daada man ɗam uddi. 

Poti waɗeede ko yaawningol ɗaɓɓere ndiyam man (IV line) ngam ɗam ɗoofta ɓeyda yahde, kisa yo ɓeydane mo ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) e nder ƴiiƴam. 

Sabu daada man ɗam uddi, ko haanjii yo o nana ñawbuuji ɓamtaari (antibiotics) ko wayi no Ceftriaxone e Metronidazole rewrude e ƴiiƴam ngam haɗde sibawu ɗam. 

So o fuɗɗi jaɓde, o waawi yarde ndiyam laaɓtungam walla ORS, kono ko haanjii o wona e nder opitaal ngam ƴeewtaade ƴiiƴam makko (Hb) e ƴiiƴam jaɓɓorgo (urine output) ngonka makko. 

Ɓaawo ɗuum, ƴettude kuutorɗe njam (Iron) e Folic acid maa wallu mo ɓeydude ƴiiƴam makko ɗam o majjii.
